d:
Disaster !
The heroic plumber has been captured ! But just when all hopes seemed lost... a light appeared ! Princess Peach was decided to stand alone against Bowser's oppression. Armed only with hers fists and feet, she set off towards his Bowser's castle to try to save her man ! Will she manage to outwit all the traps set by her sworn enemy?
